purpose: Review of P-0002 (lone species-C free flight with specular walls, T=40) for the third in-domain run: a different start (8.5,1.5) and velocity (2.0,-3.5), which reflects off y=0 and then off other walls. Pre-registered: the paper's predict() gives error (RMSE/10) at or below 0.03 for replication; above 0.03 is falsification. Cost 1.8 review credits.
